The [[Water Lord]] is a [[Djinn]] [[boss]]  that must be defeated to acquire its essence for [[Library Envoy Chukeht]].

==Locations==
* [[Vabbi]]
** {{NPC location|The Hidden City of Ahdashim}} (only during [[Gift of the Djinn]])

==Skills==
* {{Skill icon|Balthazar's Rage}}
* {{Skill icon|Crippling Sweep}}
* {{Skill icon|Eremite's Attack}}
* {{Skill icon|Lyssa's Assault}}
* {{Skill icon|Vow of Silence}} ([[elite]])

== Notes ==
* The djinn does not actually drop an essence that needs to be picked up. Killing it will immediately update the quest.
